name: openl
description: Work with OpenL Studio from Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code — manage rules, projects, tables and tests over the OpenL MCP server.

OPENL_STUDIO_URL.title: OpenL Studio address
OPENL_STUDIO_URL.description: The address you open in your browser to use OpenL Studio, e.g. https://studio.example.com

OPENL_STUDIO_TOKEN.title: Personal Access Token
OPENL_STUDIO_TOKEN.description: Create one in OpenL Studio under User → Personal Access Tokens, then paste it here. This is how Cursor signs in as you. Leave empty only for a single-user Studio that has no sign-in.
